<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, carbons in the 10‑30 ppm range correspond to aliphatic methyl groups (16.6, 19.4, 24.6 ppm). Additionally, a carbon at ~57 ppm is typical for a methoxy (O‑CH₃) carbon, which is also a methyl group. Therefore the molecule contains four CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
